Advisory service

Insurance Claims Assistance

A claim goes better when the first steps are right. Chestnut helps clients understand their policy, prepare documents and follow up with the insurer. We cannot promise a settlement, which depends on the policy terms and the facts of the loss.

Chat on WhatsAppCall 0721 233 951

What we do

  • Help you understand what your policy says about your loss
  • Tell you what documents the insurer is likely to ask for
  • Help you prepare and submit a clear claim
  • Follow up with the insurer and keep you informed
  • Explain assessor, repair and settlement steps as they arise

How it works

  1. Report to your insurer

    Notify the insurer as your policy requires, as soon as reasonably possible. Do not wait to contact us first if a deadline applies.

  2. Protect the evidence

    Take photos, keep damaged items where safe to do so and do not admit liability to others.

  3. Contact Chestnut

    Tell us what happened. We guide you on documents and next steps.

  4. Submit and follow up

    We help you file and chase, and explain the insurer’s response.

What to have ready

  • Policy number and insurer
  • Date, place and description of the incident
  • Photos, police abstract or other evidence where relevant
  • Quotations or invoices for repair or replacement

Please note

  • Settlement depends on the policy, its exclusions and conditions, and the insurer’s assessment.
  • We do not guarantee any claim outcome or timeline.
  • In an emergency, contact the relevant emergency services first.

Questions

How soon should I report a claim?

As soon as reasonably possible. Many policies set time limits for notification. Check your policy and notify the insurer.

Can you help with a claim on a policy I did not buy through Chestnut?

Please contact us and tell us what happened. We will explain what help we can offer.
